h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Surendranagar Dudhrej

items.pText: Salt is a problem for outdoor equipment in Surendranagar district, even far from the sea. The soil and groundwater here carry salt from the edge of the Little Rann of Kutch, and that attacks steel where it meets the ground. FunPlay Systems makes outdoor playground equipment for schools, societies and gardens in Surendranagar and Dudhrej at our factory in Vasai East, about 400 km away.

The twin towns lie in the Jhalawad area of Gujarat, a hot and dry cotton-growing region with a short monsoon. We deliver by road and install through our own team or a dealer in western India. Share the size of your site, photos and the age group of the children. In return you get a list of suggested pieces and a drawing that marks the safe play area around each.

richText.heading: Protecting posts from saline soil and hard water

c: The weakest point on any post is where it enters the ground, because moisture and salt collect there. Grout the post into a concrete footing and finish the concrete a little above ground level, sloped so water runs away from the pipe. This keeps the galvanised steel out of direct contact with salty, damp soil.

Avoid watering a lawn right up to the posts with salty borewell water. If you wash the equipment, use fresh water where you can. Roto-moulded plastic parts do not corrode at all. Summers are very hot, so plan shade. See nearby

items.q: Does saline soil damage playground equipment?
items.a: Salt and moisture can attack steel where it meets the ground. Grouting posts into concrete that finishes above ground level, and using galvanised steel, protects the base of each post.

items.q: Can we wash the equipment with borewell water?
items.a: Fresh water is better if your borewell water is salty or hard. Rinse with fresh water where possible and keep wet lawns away from the base of the posts.
